releases.notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
This version is made for Noxesium 3.0.0, [download it here](https://modrinth.com/mod/noxesium/version/3.0.0).

## What's Changed
* Fix pkw split icons by @LukynkaCZE in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/203
* Fix music settings not saving properly by @LukynkaCZE in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/205
* Fix non-existing JSON object causing NullPointerException on initializing by @violine1101 in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/206
* Weapon Skin preview + new Island Update fixes by @pe3ep in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/209
* Fix Discord RPC crashes on Apple Silicon macs by @pe3ep in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/210
* chore: Update to 1.21.11 and Noxesium v3.0.0 by @pe3ep in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/211

## New Contributors
* @pe3ep made their first contribution in https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/pull/209

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AsoDesu/IslandUtils/compare/1.7.3+1.21.8...1.7.4
